body:
[A10] An addendum to the 13:15 ruling (issuecomment-6522621984), on the area record during the release.

Re-recording the record in each PR would make #806, #787, #817 and #70 conflict on the same record rows. Each of them would then need a merge-of-dev round and a re-route.

Instead:
- each release adoption is judged on its own route set under #818;
- the record is re-recorded once on dev, after the last release merge, from the release image's three-directive routes;
- a record that does not yet carry an adoption's route is not a finding against that PR.

The floor rule is unchanged.
